text:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged rollout v2.7.3 -> 5% traffic on /generate (change window 45m). Model: redwood/mistral-v2-quant@sha256:ab12cd. Release notes: https://go/internal/release/2.7.3 :rocket:

alice: rolling now. monitoring: p95 latency, errors, and kv-cache evictions. change window ends in 40m. @dmitri please hold on call if anything abnormal :eyes:

dmitri: watching. threshold: errors > 1% OR p95 > 300ms => hold. will sample traces and mute noisy keys.

ben: seeing small blip at 5% (error rate +0.8% over baseline), still within guardrail but kv eviction rate trending up. dashboard: https://dash.internal/rollouts/2245012345

carol: FYI model memory map shows increased activation working set for longer contexts, could bump kv cache pressure. putting a watch on eviction per-pod.

ben: spike now 2.3% errors, two pods showing OOM kill/restart in the last 60s. logs: ```kubectl logs inference-ss-7f8 -n infra | tail -n 40
2024-11-02T15:14:23Z ERR kvcache: eviction triggered, mem=94%
2024-11-02T15:15:01Z CRIT runtime: oom killed process 
```

alice: that's outside our threshold. proposed action: stop rollout and pin back to v2.7.2. @pm-sam any product impact concerns?

pm-sam: Stop. user-visible errors are happening (rate-limited retries increasing). prefer rollback and postmortem. :+1:

dmitri: Stop. I'll coordinate rollback and collect traces for RCA.

carol: Stop and pin agreed. quick command to pin traffic: `/deploy pin-version --service=inference --route=stable --version=redwood/mistral-v2-quant@sha256:9f8e7d`

ben: initiating rollback now — scaling old variant up and draining new pods. Running: `kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=redwood/mistral-v2:9f8e7d -n infra`

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by ben. Target state: canary 0% -> stable model redwood/mistral-v2@sha256:9f8e7d. ETA 7 minutes. Notifying oncall and product.

ben: rollback complete. routing back to v2.7.2, p95 latency back to baseline, error rate down to 0.3%. verified by traces and health checks.

alice: thanks. action items: 1) increase kv-cache memory allocation for inference pool, 2) add smoky test with long-context workload in preflight for future canaries, 3) update release notes with observed regression and mitigation steps. I'll create the follow-up ticket.

pm-sam: please tag customer-impacting sessions for RCA.

dmitri: collecting logs/traces now, will post a short incident blameless postmortem in #postmortems within 24h.

alice: closing thread. thanks all — we'll reattempt rollout after mitigation and a shorter canary with synthetic load. :white_check_mark:
